Name: Ithai, Son of Ribai
Summary: Son of Ribai of Gibeah of Benjamin, one of David's valiant men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:31: Son of Ribai of Gibeah of Benjamin, one of David's valiant men.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ithai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
